company.shortDescription: Aurora Solar is a SaaS company that uses aerial imagery to assess solar installation projects.
company.description: Aurora Solar develops solar industry software. It develops cloud-based software, that enables solar PV engineering design, provides workflow management functionality, and facilitates sales and customer acquisition for solar installers and financiers.

aiResearchSummary.text: Aurora Solar is engaged in developing systems for constructing three-dimensional representations of roof structures, as described in '3d building modeling system.' Their work includes methods for automated three-dimensional building model estimation, which predict rooftop outlines, pitches, and heights using aerial imagery and 3D data. These areas of research and development focus on leveraging aerial imagery and modeling techniques to assess and represent complex roof structures for solar installation projects.
